title: Am I doing marketing right?
author: TheUniverseOrNothing
selftext:
Someone said I needed to make 15-30 second clips for my game.

I don’t like streaming and refuse to be on camera or use my own voice. This is the best I can offer. /s

comments.author: Captain_Slib
comments.body:
Rehashing a format already used to death? 

On par for r/aigamedev

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
You’re not wrong, so what’s a better format?

This was extremely stupid but it still got 20k views and more people trying my game.

So what’s the solution? Do I avoid the low hanging fruit even if it works for TikTok or fb audiences?

comments.author: JakSilver00
comments.body: Yeah, if you want to use the same kind of marketing tactics that all of those gambling ads use don't be surprised when people think that's what your game is though.

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body: Good point. This game isn’t one of those gambling apps and will never charge anyone for in game currency etc… so that’s actually a reason to not do this, thank you!

comments.author: PimientosAsados
comments.body: I think you are doing a great job, honestly.
